require_single_part2_input.description: Selection-only constraint: retain candidates whose generated Part-2 ONNX has exactly one external graph input. Generic execution remains multi-input/multi-output capable.

score_independent_audit_enabled.description: Compatibility flag for selection_strategy=score_independent_audit. The audit is selected without predictor scores or benchmark measurements.

audit_candidate_universe.description: Global candidate-universe mode used by score-independent audits.

audit_size.description: Global number of deterministic score-independent audit candidates per model.

minimum_valid_audit_candidates.description: Global minimum number of valid audit candidates required for ranking evidence.

audit_seed.description: Global deterministic seed for score-independent candidate-audit selection.

forced_cases.description: Optional exact case ids per model for small native smoke runs, e.g. {resnet50:[b052], yolo26s:[b038]}.

fixed_cases.description: Optional exact case ids per model for small native smoke runs, e.g. {resnet50:[b052], yolo26s:[b038]}.

dependency_manifest.description: Optional Hailo8 dependency overlay. Omit to inherit explicit environment selection; empty string explicitly disables overlay.

deepx_build.description: DeepX DX-COM build settings for ONNX -> DXNN artifacts.

compiler_overlay.description: Compiler-local optional Torch overlay; never applied to GUI or remote runtime.

classification_preprocessing.description: Regular DeepX classification uses imagenet_mean_std. current_scale_only is restricted to explicit Legacy/A-B diagnostics.

deepx_runtime.description: DeepX DX-RT runtime settings for remote NX execution.

hardware.description: Selected runtime hardware setups/groups for multi-accelerator evaluation runs.

hardware_groups.description: Inline hardware setup groups by group id.

hardware_targets.description: Per-accelerator deployment/runtime targets. Each entry can point to a different Orin NX host.

requested.description: Authoritative v2.63 request flag. Legacy profiles without this field continue to use energy.enabled or native_producers.energy.enabled.

primary_method.description: Frozen scientific primary for v2.67 and later.

shadow_method.description: Non-blocking same-trace sensitivity result using the Chapter-4 window method.

baseline_method.description: Read-compatible v2.63-v2.66 input alias; new profiles use primary_method/shadow_method.

candidate_method.description: Read-compatible v2.63-v2.66 input alias; new profiles use primary_method/shadow_method.

final_all_split_energy.description: GUI thesis/final preset: require row-level energy for all thesis-relevant complete split rows. Forces row_variant scope, target_policy=all, max_targets_per_run_id=0 and strict energy. CPU ORT can be excluded via final_energy_skip_cpu_ort.

final_energy_skip_cpu_ort.description: When final_all_split_energy is enabled, skip CPU ORT row-level u.RECS energy and exclude CPU ORT split diagnostics from energy completeness gating. Default true in the GUI because CPU ORT windows are slow and not accelerator-relevant.

include_cpu_ort_in_final_energy.description: Advanced opt-in: measure CPU ORT even in final all-split energy mode.

native_producers.description: Optional native producer fastpath configuration. Native producer is a strict supported-only execution mode for optimized accelerator->TensorRT pipelines and native full baselines.

repetitions.description: Independent Native performance repetitions aggregated as median and confidence interval; never best-of.

window_method_validation_probe.description: Separate screening-only marker-v2 versus historical-window probe; it never relaxes Native Energy pairing or enters scientific energy results.

max_acquisition_retries.description: Fresh outer collector retries per logical probe repeat; the inner exact-run collector always uses zero retries.

artifact_store.description: Resolved unified compiler-artifact library policy from the selected run mode.

build_scheduler.description: Resolved resource-aware local compiler scheduler policy from the selected run mode.

artifactCachePreflightPolicy.description: Read-only cache readiness policy. Diagnostic by default; blocking requires an explicit strict policy.

require_warm_cache.description: Strict convenience policy; also selects warm as the default expectation when no expectation is specified.

audit_size.description: Legacy per-model override retained for profile compatibility. New profiles store this value globally as selection_policy.audit_size.

minimum_valid_candidates.description: Legacy per-model override retained for profile compatibility. New profiles store this value globally as selection_policy.minimum_valid_audit_candidates.

seed.description: Legacy per-model override retained for profile compatibility. New profiles store this value globally as selection_policy.audit_seed.

activation_calibration_source.description: Optional Stage-2 activation calibration evidence/source used by accelerator split runs, e.g. activation_proxy_cache.

activation_proxy_backend.description: Optional requested activation proxy backend for this run, e.g. ort_cpu, cuda_ort, remote_deepx_tensorrt.

compiler_overlay.description: Compiler-local optional Torch overlay; never applied to GUI or remote runtime.
